name: paged
description: Two-page LIMIT/OFFSET walk over upt_assets. Page one is exactly the 200-row page size, so the walk must continue; page two is short and must end it. Proves the second asset query carries OFFSET 200, that the per-page enrichment queries rebuild their WHERE upt_asset_id IN (...) list from the SECOND page's ids rather than reusing the first page's, and that no third page is requested. The IN list is also the injection guard: ids are rendered through a strict allowlist before being interpolated into SQL.

requests_include.body_contains: SELECT * FROM upt_assets ORDER BY id LIMIT 200 OFFSET 0
SELECT * FROM upt_assets ORDER BY id LIMIT 200 OFFSET 200
